context.label: Antioch and the first mission

observations.body: The Spirit sends Barnabas and Saul to Cyprus. Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul. Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

payload.posture: Read Acts 13:1–12 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the Spirit sends Barnabas and Saul to Cyprus. Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul. Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
